drawings.description: schéma de la marge gauche ; au-dessous, un second schéma du même genre ($X_0$, $X$, $E$, $k_0$, $A_0$, $k$, $\mathbb{Q}$) est couvert de hachures et de traits, illisible
drawings.kind: two diagrams of fields and schemes (margin), the second hatched over
drawings.notes: Upper figure: the margin diagram X_0 - X over k_0 - A_0 - k, with the two vertical strokes, as the transcription sets it in tikz-cd (the upper left letter is read X_0 after the transcription). Lower figure: the second diagram of the same kind, covered with hatching and loops; only its principal strokes and the legible labels are drawn (E, k_0, A_0 twice, X_0, X, k), the hatched area as a hatched polygon, and two of the enclosing loops in pencil. The Q the transcription lists is not located with certainty (perhaps the loop at the bottom left) and is left out; the remaining crossing strokes and loops are left out.
